request.style: English, solemn male tenor solo with deep choir, organ, harp, timpani, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ahab walked in Jeroboam's sins
He took as his wife Jezebel
Daughter of Ethbaal, king of Sidonians
He went and served Baal

[Verse]
An altar for Baal in Samaria
Built within the temple walls
Ahab also made an Asherah pole
To provoke the Lord's anger

[Verse]
Jezebel was killing off the prophets
Obadiah hid them in a cave
Fifty in a cave with bread and water
Preserved by faithful hands

[Verse]
Gather Israel to Mount Carmel
Prophets of Baal and Asherah
Four hundred fifty shout and dance
But there is no sound or answer

[Verse]
Elijah repaired the altar
Twelve stones for Jacob's tribes
Four jars of water poured around
The trench ran full with water

[Verse]
Fire of the Lord fell from heaven
Consumed the wood and stones
The people fell facedown and cried
The Lord is God indeed

[Outro]
Seize the prophets of Baal
